text: Confidence regularization applied to the student's predictions, with a regularization weight of 1.0, was evaluated on the ethics_justice testbed across 16 seeds. The measured performance gap recovered (PGR) was 0.19, with a standard error of 0.08. Because no baseline PGR is reported in the available data, this result cannot be characterized as an improvement over any comparison condition; it should be read only as the absolute level of gap recovery observed under this configuration. The standard error is appreciable relative to the point estimate, so the underlying value is not pinned down tightly by these 16 seeds, and readers should treat 0.19 as a central estimate carrying meaningful uncertainty rather than a settled quantity. Interpretation is further limited to the single testbed and the single regularization weight examined here; no claim can be made about how the method behaves at other weights, on other tasks, or against alternative training schemes without additional runs.
